chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Faddal from Ibn Bukayr from Zurarah who said:
I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about the person performing Hajj al-Mufrad: when he enters Mecca, does he advance his Tawaf or delay it? He said, 'It is the same.'

key_terms.اَلْمُفْرِدُ لِلْحَجِّ: The person performing Hajj al-Mufrad (single Hajj)

ai.seo_question: When should a pilgrim performing Hajj al-Mufrad perform their Tawaf upon entering Mecca?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* and transmitted through the reliable chain of Zurarah, this hadith clarifies the ritual flexibility for a Mufrid pilgrim regarding the timing of their initial Tawaf al-Qudum. The Imam’s affirmation that advancing or delaying the Tawaf is equivalent underscores the ease (*rukhas*) in Hajj rituals, distinguishing it from the stricter sequencing required in Hajj al-Qiran or Tamattu'.
